rationale: The most recent 5-minute candle probed to today's high of $57.01 but closed back at $56.60, forming a bearish rejection wick at the upper range extreme (91.7% of day's range), while price remains meaningfully below the session VWAP of $57.36 which represents overhead supply from the gap-down open.
